discrepancy.note: The nine category subtotals sum to 1360; the syllabus total row reads 1355. Not reconciled with the instructor. This app computes against 1360 and shows both. 5 points is 0.37% — enough to move a borderline letter.

grading.scaleNote: There is no C- on her scale. Anything from 70.0 to 76.9 is a C.

categories.name: Embedded Video Quizzes
categories.note: Her syllabus says only "points are variable" and fixes the category total at 50. No individual items are known, so none are invented; the 50 points sit in the denominator as an unplaced budget.

unplaced.note: 16 application assignments are promised; 12 have a week. She says "Some weeks will have two application activities" without saying which, so the remaining 4 are held here rather than given invented dates.
6 reflections are promised and the "even weeks" rule places only 5 (weeks 2,4,6,8,10). The sixth is unplaced — likely the wrap week.
Category total is fixed at 50 but no individual quizzes are enumerated anywhere.

latePolicy.penaltyIfUnused: Not stated in the syllabus — confirm with the instructor.
latePolicy.note: Three late coupons, each buying 7 no-penalty days. Nothing is accepted after 2026-12-05, "even if that is less than 7 days after the due date. NO EXCEPTIONS."
latePolicy.hardStopWarning: 2026-12-05 is a Saturday that falls the day BEFORE the inferred Week 11 deadline (2026-12-06), so Week 11 work cannot be couponed at all.

moduleRules.note: Modules open weekly on Sundays and must be completed in order — you cannot jump between assignments within a module.
